package.description: GUI for remote operation of the DC40 4.0 A LED Driver.

en-US.description: GUI for remote operation of the DC40 4.0 A LED Driver.
en-US.longDescription: The Software for Thorlabs' DC40 4.0 A LED Driver includes a GUI which enables remote control of up to 10 DC40 LED Drivers in parallel. This software allows for the DC40 driver to be completely controlled through the GUI or in tandem with manual adjustment using the physical inputs on the device. While using the GUI Software, the set current and current limit can be precisely saved for later applications. The GUI Software also enables the use of LEDs without Thorlabs' EEPROM technology.
en-US.name: Thorlabs DC40

zh-CN.description: 远程操作 DC40 4.0 A LED 驱动器的图形用户界面 (GUI)
zh-CN.longDescription: Thorlabs DC40 4.0A LED 驱动器的配套软件包含一个图形用户界面 (GUI)，可实现对多达 10 台 DC40 LED 驱动器的并行远程控制。该软件支持通过 GUI 界面完全控制 DC40 驱动器，也可与设备上的物理输入旋钮配合进行手动调节。在使用 GUI 软件时，用户可精确保存所设置的电流值和电流限值以供后续应用。该 GUI 软件还支持使用非 Thorlabs EEPROM 技术的 LED 器件。
